data.name: OC桌面管理器
data.detailed_description:
Here you can effortlessly create and manage your original characters (OCs), guiding them through wonderful adventures in diverse scenarios.

Key Features

Effortless OC Game Character Import & Management

The OC Desktop Manager offers an exceptionally user-friendly character creation system. With simple drag-and-drop operations, you can import various assets into the character design interface. Even newcomers without prior game development experience can master it within minutes, crafting personalized desktop pets with ease. Robust management tools allow you to store and edit created characters anytime, enabling quick deployment across different game scenarios.

Diverse Game Scene Templates

To enrich your OCs' companionship experience, we provide a variety of game scene templates. Choose from adorable desktop pet companion modes for cozy moments during work/study sessions, or explore classic templates like top-down view, side-scrolling layouts, and 45-degree isometric OC rooms. Customize layouts and decorations to match your preferences.

Continuous Updates & Expansion

Our development team is committed to regularly injecting fresh content into the game. Updates will introduce new scene templates and functional optimizations. We actively listen to player feedback, incorporating your suggestions into future development phases – making you an integral part of the game's evolution.
